name: Serge Karloff (Sergey Karlov)
bio: Solo AI filmmaker behind ARK-7, who produced the series' pilot episode for about $1,000.
bioMore: Working under the name Serge Karloff, Sergey Karlov released ARK-7's pilot episode on August 29, 2026, covering model subscriptions, generation credits, image and video generation, upscaling, voice, music, and editing and post-production software for roughly $1,000 total. He describes the work as thinking simultaneously as director, production designer, continuity supervisor and pipeline designer, rather than as a prompt engineer. ARK-7 was entered in the Open Competition at the Astana AI Film Festival, held October 1–3, 2026. Beyond the series itself, he has said his longer-term interest is the production model behind it as much as the show.
